description: Printable replacement screw cap for a PCO 1881 PET bottle neck, no tether. Straight-knurled skirt, internal thread, 1.2 mm top wall.
assumptions: Height 17 mm is the full cap height measured from the sealing rim at the bottom to the flat top face.
Outer diameter 33 mm is the outside of the knurl crests; skirt land diameter is that minus the knurl depth.
The photo cannot show wall thickness, thread depth, or the inside of the cap; those come from the user's numbers and PCO 1881 practice, not from the image.
Internal thread is modelled metal-free at the stated 27.4 mm thread OD with a print clearance for FDM.
The tether, tamper-evident band and top-surface branding in the photo are deliberately omitted.
